description: This file is a Java test class for the FixedDepositAccountInterestCalculationServiceImpl, containing unit tests that verify the correctness of interest calculation logic within the service. It mocks dependencies such as DepositAccountDataValidator, FromJsonHelper, and static methods from MoneyHelper. The tests compute interest based on sample input values and check that the results match expected BigDecimal values.
